title: Expected free energy selects action and yields curiosity

statements.text: The most likely course of action is the one with least expected free energy. Expected free energy combines a pragmatic term (reaching preferred outcomes) with an epistemic term (resolving uncertainty), so information seeking follows from the same objective.

sources.quote: Expected free energy plays a definitive role in active inference, where it can be regarded as a fairly universal objective function for selecting autonomous paths of least action.
providing a formal explanation for reward seeking, context learning, and epistemic foraging.
